response.note_text:
History: 53F with DM and HTN (elevated readings documented by other clinicians, not yet on meds) c/o exertional chest pain x3 months. Dull, pressure-like, brought on by walking, no radiation. Lately unable to keep up with walking due to pain. Pain-free now; no SOB, sweats or clamminess now. FHx heart disease. DM: on metformin, sugars a little higher with less activity, working on diet, likes sodas. No N/V/D or metformin side effects. Ophthalmology appt in 2 wks. Pt unaware of HTN.
Exam: No JVD, no neck swelling, no carotid bruits. Lungs clear, no crackles or rhonchi. Heart RRR, 2/6 systolic ejection murmur (known). Pulses equal. Abd soft, NT, no guarding, no masses. Back normal. Ext: 1+ nonpitting ankle edema, no calf tenderness.
Results: EKG in office: normal, no signs of MI. Last HbA1c 7.
Assessment: 1. Chest pain, suspected unstable angina given DM, suspected HTN and FHx heart disease. 2. DM, fairly well controlled. 3. HTN, elevated BP trend.
Plan: 1. Refer cardiology, aim for next week; stress test. Start ASA 81 mg daily. NTG SL prn chest pain not relieved by rest, up to 3 doses q5 min; if not resolved call 911/go to hospital. 2. Continue metformin 500 mg BID. HbA1c today. Keep ophthalmology appt for retinopathy exam. Avoid soda and sweets; resume exercise once cardiac workup done. 3. Start low-dose HCTZ (also for leg swelling). Side effects discussed (urinary frequency, sulfa cross-reaction), handout given. Home BP cuff, daily morning log in MyChart. F/u 2 wks.
To follow up: ask about rest pain or worsening pattern; ask about SOB, diaphoresis, nausea, syncope during episodes; smoking, lipids and FHx details; allergies (sulfa, aspirin) and bleeding/ulcer history; orthopnea, PND, weight gain and echo for murmur/edema; reconsider outpatient workup vs same-day eval if unstable angina suspected; clarify single NTG/911 instruction; document BP, check BMP and urine albumin, consider ACEi/ARB instead of HCTZ; consider lipid panel and statin.
